flows.title: Add a sending domain
steps: In the Control Panel, click Send then Sending to expand the sidebar, then click Domains.
Click the Add new domain button in the upper right corner.
Enter your domain name in the Domain name field, select a Domain region, and choose an IP assignment option.

flows.title: Find a message in the logs
steps: Open the Logs tab in the Control Panel to view and search every event that happened to your messages.
Search by fields such as recipient, subject line, or message-id to find the message you're looking for.

flows.title: Manage unsubscribed addresses
steps: Go to the Suppressions tab in the Control Panel.
View the list of unsubscribed addresses.
Remove an address from the list, or add a new unsubscribed address.
